subject: Reschedule request: Production workflow demo — align with CTO arrival
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@brightworks.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo: Production workflow walkthrough — Thurs May 13 (confirming sponsor attendance)

Jordan / Marta —

Thanks again for carving out time for the production workflow walkthrough next Thursday. Proposed slot was 11:30 AM PT (60 min) to cover end-to-end flow, canary metrics, and runbook. Grace (VP) has indicated she'd like to join the exec portion if the CTO can attend.

Heads-up: Jordan mentioned CTO has a tight travel window and may clear customs late on Thursday — there’s a chance he can only join after landing. Before I lock the calendar: would BrightWorks prefer we shift earlier to guarantee CTO attendance, or keep 11:30 and plan for a 20–30 minute exec touchpoint when/if he arrives?

I've attached an updated agenda (prod-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) that splits the session into a technical deep-dive (first 30–40 mins) and an exec summary (final 20 mins). If you prefer, we can send two invites (concise 30-min slot + 30-min exec follow) to make it explicit.

Proposed alternatives:
- Move to 10:00 AM PT (condensed 45m) to capture CTO before transit
- Keep 11:30 AM PT and run condensed technical demo at 10:00 with Karthik covering technical Qs; VP/CTO join 11:30 for exec part

Can you confirm which you prefer? If you want the earlier slot, I can rebook on our side and send updated invites.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: prod-demo-agenda-v2.pdf

From: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@brightworks.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta@brightworks.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: Production workflow walkthrough — Thurs May 13 (confirming sponsor attendance)

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 9:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan / Marta —
> 
> Thanks again for carving out time for the production workflow walkthrough next Thursday. Proposed slot was 11:30 AM PT (60 min) ...

Thanks, Alex. Appreciate the split agenda — very helpful. Quick update from our side: the CTO's flight was delayed in Madrid and then hit a long customs line; he's arriving later than expected and I can't confidently promise he'll be on for 11:30.

Marta (cc'd) and I prefer an earlier slot if possible — 10:00 AM PT would be ideal to get the CTO in the call before departure. If 10:00 doesn't work for your team, the fallback plan of Karthik running the technical portion at 10:00 with the exec summary at 11:30 would be acceptable.

Two asks: can you (1) check whether your team can compress to a 45m session at 10:00, and (2) if not, create the two-invite approach so we know when to join for the exec portion?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Reed
Head of Platform, BrightWorks

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@brightworks.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: Production workflow walkthrough — Thurs May 13 (confirming sponsor attendance)

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads-up and for flagging timing. Two practical options we can own from Redwood:

1) Move the full demo to 10:00 AM PT (45–50m): we can compress the technical demo and keep the exec wrap to ~10m; Karthik will lead the demo and I will join for the last 10–15 minutes for the exec Q&A.

2) Keep the main 11:30 AM PT slot and add a short 10:00 AM PT technical dry run (30m) where Karthik runs the core flow for your engineers. If the CTO clears customs early we can merge; otherwise the exec conversation remains at 11:30.

My preference is option 2 — it preserves the full 11:30 exec window while giving your team the technical coverage earlier. It also reduces the risk of the CTO missing the technical nuance if he only makes the tail end.

Alex — can you create both calendar events (10:00 tech dry run + 11:30 exec walkthrough) and mark the 11:30 event as "Exec summary — optional for engineers"? I'll be on both. Karthik will prepare a 30-min tech deck + live canary demo notes (he's included).

Grace O'Connor
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@brightworks.com>, Marta Alvarez <marta@brightworks.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Technical dry run 10:00 AM PT + Exec summary 11:30 AM PT — May 13

Jordan / Marta —

Thanks — plan confirmed. Per Grace's suggestion I've created two calendar events and sent invites:

- PROD Demo — Technical dry run (30m) 
  When: Thu, May 13, 10:00 AM PT
  Owner: Karthik Iyer (technical lead)
  Purpose: condensed flow + canary metrics and runbook Qs

- PROD Demo — Exec summary (30m)
  When: Thu, May 13, 11:30 AM PT
  Owner: Grace O'Connor (exec summary)
  Purpose: exec-level outcomes, risk profile, next steps

Attached: prod-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (split agenda) and canary-run-notes.txt. I've also linked the deal Jira (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CRM-1427) and the shared agenda in Drive. If the CTO is able to join the 11:30 slot we will make time to loop him in live; otherwise we will record the exec summary and share notes.

If anything changes on your side (boarding clears / new timing), reply all and we'll either collapse the two events into one or adjust accordingly.

See you Thursday —
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: prod-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, canary-run-notes.txt
